title: Myth vs Fact
text: Earth has weathered about 4.5 billion years and roughly 20 trips around the center of the Milky Way, and it's still in one piece. Most people don't know we orbit the Milky Way. About 4.5 billion years rounds the U.S. Geological Survey age of 4.54 billion years. NASA Science gives about 230 million years for one galactic year. An older NASA page gives 250 million years. Roughly 20 trips divides that age by a galactic year. USGS: Age of the Earth. NASA Science: about 230 million years. NASA: 250 million years.

title: Deep Time
text: Deep Time. One bright line walks 539 million years, and the animals ride their continents the whole way. Five mass extinctions are marked as you pass them. This is who lived, who vanished, and where the land was.
